test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), has organised '________' to celebrate five years of Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) and two years of Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) on 25th and 26th September 2023 in New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arogya Manthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arogya Manthan** is the event organized by the National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW).
 
• The event celebrates **five years of Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)** and **two years of Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)**.
 
• It is scheduled to be held on **25th and 26th September 2023** in **New Delhi**.
 
• Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is a flagship scheme of the Government of India to provide health coverage to economically vulnerable families.
 
• Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission aims to create a digital health ecosystem in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)** was launched on 23rd September 2018.
 
• It provides health coverage of up to **₹5 lakhs per family per year** for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)** aims to develop the backbone necessary to support the integrated digital health infrastructure of the country.
 
• The National Health Authority (NHA) is responsible for the implementation of both AB PM-JAY and ABDM.
